text:
[Council File 26-0335; CD 6]
Motion (Padilla – Lee) relative to designating the intersection of Terra Bella Street and Woodman Avenue as “Veterans Memorial Square." The subtext of the sign should read “In Memory of Sgt. Adrian Carrillo, USMC.”
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Designating the intersection of Terra Bella Street and Woodman Avenue as Veterans Memorial Square in memory of Sgt. Adrian Carrillo.

locations.text: Terra Bella Street & Woodman Avenue, Los Angeles, CA

outcome.text: Public Works Committee approved item(s) (Aug 12, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 28, 2026); Council action final
